title: A Projected Semiexplicit Integrator for Dissipative Systems with Configuration-Dependent Kinetic Energy: Contact-Herglotz Formulation and Benchmarks
summary: Contact Hamiltonian dynamics gives dissipative mechanics an intrinsic action variable, but explicit contact splittings reach only kinetic energies whose terms are exactly integrable: frozen-coordinate diagonal metrics (the spherical pendulum, a torus particle) are included, while dense metrics with momentum cross terms, with the double pendulum as flagship, are not.
